title: At-scale CS1 exercises and problem sets
summary: Students complete chapter exercises and problem sets containing multiple-choice, fill-in-the-blank, and live coding questions with unlimited attempts. ChatGPT was tested offline on these tasks; for-credit students are expected to rely on proctored quizzes and tests as separate evidence of understanding.
